name: Hashimoto (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hashimoto city emblem in navy: a stylised device of a ring with a disc above a curved base, like a bridge.
history: Municipal flag of Hashimoto, a city in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 January 1955.

features.role: Hashimoto city emblem — a stylised device of a ring with a disc above a curved base, like a bridge
